title: I'm still not sure if I've been to Mall World. Has anyone else had experiences like the following:
content: I’m still not sure if I’ve been to Mall World or not. I am sure that I started to dream a lot about malls, libraries, and museums somewhere around my early 20s. I’m in my late 30s now so that was around the time of the whole “web 2.0” rollout. I suspected, and still suspect that those dreams offered a physical manifestation of the endless information and opportunities newly at my fingertips. My personal theory about Mall World (weather I’ve seen it or not) is that it’s either a physical manifestation of the raw power and information of the internet (not so different from the more common Jung theory). That or I’d believe what others have said about it being some kind of transit hub. It makes sense to me that whatever it is, we all use a bit of imagination to process and articulate it, which would lead to many small inconsistencies. The closest thing I have to a Mall World dream is that once I had a dream about a mall I have called “Tall Mall”. It seemed infinitely tall, although I have no memory of how it’s heights were traversed. There was for sure a grocery store on the ground level, and it looked kind of dingy and retro, although in my version it was otherwise pretty normal. After buying groceries I started heading to the top of the mall. It was weirdly empty. Eventually, I got to where I was going, which was a convention inside a hotel. There I met and interacted with an anthropomorphic animal. I won’t say what kind of animal or what the interaction was like, but I’m open to comments and DMs about whether you’ve met any anthropomorphic animals or high tech furries. Another possible Mall World dream I had involved the whole dreamscape being owned (or at least sponsored) by a corporation. I do remember it’s name and the gist of it’s logo if anyone cares to share with me anything along those lines they might remember. Another thing is I have been to consistent dreamscapes that are not alternate versions of where I live. I do wonder if these could be parts of Mall World. For a while I could only go underground, which others have mentioned. Then I could only run around on rooftops. A lot of the roofs were attached to each other. They did seem like perhaps beach houses. This scape had an abundance of treehouses. The treehouses were wonderful. I could just hang out in them, move into them until I felt like traveling further. There was a slightly eerie, liminal space feeling about them when you first stepped in, but the would start to feel like home pretty soon after. There was this sort of run-down arcade that I could basically live at as well. Sometimes a guy worked there who was super chill, other times it seemed abandoned but still in pretty good shape considering. I think there might have been a truck stop/diner near there though things move around some Finally, sometimes I have this dream where I walk away from a mall and into a residential area, and there are swimming pools everywhere! Great big ones. All different shapes and sizes. It’s always overcast and the water looks that freaky green color, thought the pools seem to be in good shape.
